financials.financial_capacity_note: Figures place Faber IA above the typical financial-capacity thresholds for a €900,000 / 5-year public contract; turnover-based eligibility ratios are met.

cost_structure.note: Hosting and inference vary materially with the hosting tier and the model option selected by the technical team.

budget_envelope.cost_efficiency_note: The sovereign HDS tier and the sovereign European model are more cost-efficient on the recurring side than the premium high-availability tier combined with top-tier proprietary inference.
budget_envelope.finance_role: Works with the architect to keep the proposed configuration within the authority's budget envelope and to preserve an acceptable margin.

commercial_posture.approach: Favours configurations that protect the gross margin and recurring-cost predictability, and arbitrates toward more cost-efficient tiers/models where the requirements allow.
commercial_posture.cost_model: Maintains a five-year cost model that can be re-run if the requirements or the budget change.
